name: Linux ESP Debug Libraries
description: Native ARM64 libatomic, libusb-1.0 and libudev for the pinned ESP GDB and OpenOCD tools.
notes: Original Debian Bookworm ARM64 packages: libatomic1 12.2.0-14+deb12u1, libusb-1.0-0 2:1.0.26-1 and libudev1 252.39-1~deb12u2. Pins verified against Packages.xz SHA-256 2ddb1737692e8c45c53e8d57c0ce4cd21c78c5703b830c3226b1423566a06c00 in the official Bookworm Release. All three payloads were byte-verified and their ELF dependencies inspected without execution. libusb needs libudev; the remaining loader, libc, pthread and gcc-base requirements come from linux-runtime. libatomic is also present in linux-build-tools with identical bytes. No udev daemon, device rules or hardware passthrough is configured.
